committees.name: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects private health care-related entities, covered entities, business associates, rural health entities, and HHS and CISA personnel.
dimensions.evidence: requires non-governmental entities in the Healthcare and Public Health Sector and covered entities and business associates to adopt minimum risk-based cybersecurity practices

dimensions.assessment: Imposes mandatory risk-based cybersecurity standards, grant programs, and revised breach reporting obligations that require concrete compliance actions.
dimensions.evidence: require non-governmental entities in the Healthcare and Public Health Sector and covered entities and business associates to adopt minimum risk-based cybersecurity practices

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes grants to eligible entities for cybersecurity adoption without detailing a total federal appropriation figure.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may award grants to eligible entities for the adoption and implementation of cybersecurity best practices.

dimensions.assessment: Amends multiple existing statutes including the HITECH Act and the Cybersecurity Act of 2015, updates HIPAA security regulations, and establishes new federal coordination and grant frameworks.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall update the security regulations under part 160 and subparts A and C of part 164 of title 45, Code of Federal Regulations

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent regulatory updates and ongoing reporting requirements, alongside multi-year grant authorities and phased effective dates.
dimensions.evidence: take effect on the date that is 36 months after the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Total authorized funding amounts for the grant program under section 10.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes mandatory cybersecurity practices, federal coordination, and grant programs for the entire health care and public health sector, directly affecting health care entities, personnel, and federal agencies.
